capabilities.description: Scores each deliverable and defense against the 5-criteria x 20-point rubric inherited from the program pack, maps totals to A/B/C/rewrite bands, and enforces the band wording supplied by the pack rather than any built-in phrasing.

capabilities.description: Maintains a weighted gradebook across memos, defenses and capstone, refusing any weight set that does not sum to 100, and runs the graduation check: average at or above the B band, all defenses passed, and the capstone accepted.
